mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carrier( CARRIER_NAME,CARRIER_LEADER, CARRIER_TEL,CARRIER_EMAIL, CARRIER_ADDRESS,CREATE_TIME,IS_DELETE ) VALUES( #{carrierName},#{carrierLeader}, #{carrierTel},#{carrierEmail}, #{carrierAddress},#{createTime},#{isDelete} )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM carrier
CARRIER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{carrierName},'%') AND CARRIER_LEADER LIKE CONCAT('%',#{carrierLeader},'%') AND CARRIER_TEL LIKE CONCAT('%',#{carrierTel},'%')
mapper.update: UPDATE carrier SET IS_DELETE=0 WHERE CARRIER_ID=#{carrierId}

update.foreach: UPDATE carrier SET IS_DELETE=0 WHERE CARRIER_ID=#{item}
